newsitem.title: USA: Three die in small plane crash near Los Angeles.
newsitem.headline: Three die in small plane crash near Los Angeles.

text.p: Three people aboard a private jet died on Saturday when it crashed into a warehouse while trying to return to the airport shortly after takeoff, officials said. No one on the ground was hurt.

The pilot of the twin-engine, French-built jet radioed the control tower at John Wayne-Orange County Airport south of Los Angeles shortly after takeoff "that they were having some kind of a problem and were returning to the airport," airport spokeswoman Pat Ware said.
She said the aircraft, which was on a local training flight, crashed about a mile from the airport. The identities of the three victims were not released pending notification of relatives.
